What stopped users

  • blocking

    In-stock vs. out-of-stock status is shown only via a small coloured dot (green vs. red). With deuteranopia both colours are indistinguishable; all dots appear the same olive/brown shade. No text, icon, or other non-colour cue is present.

    Colour blindness · Shop page — product list stock indicators
  • blocking

    'Proceed to checkout' button is focusable via Tab but does not activate with Enter or Space — it is a non-semantic element (onclick div) rather than a proper button/link, so keyboard-only users cannot reach the checkout page.

    Keyboard only · Cart page (/cart)
  • major

    The 'Proceed to checkout' button's focus outline is invisible against its dark navy background, so a keyboard user cannot tell when the button has focus.

    Keyboard only · Cart page (/cart)
  • major

    The 'Checkout' button was off-screen to the right — the cart page is 1,224px wide but the 200% zoom viewport is only 640px wide, making the checkout button inaccessible. Horizontal scrolling via scroll tool, arrow keys, Tab navigation, and scrollbar dragging all failed to reveal it.

    Low vision · Cart page
  • major

    The 'Checkout' button was not reachable via keyboard Tab navigation — only Shop, Cart, and Empty cart buttons were in the tab order, making the checkout action inaccessible to keyboard-only users.

    Low vision · Cart page
  • minor

    Blue Mug - Classic was out of stock (red dot), so had to select Blue Mug - Large instead — required reading the stock indicators carefully

    Hand tremor · Shop page
  • minor

    Blue Mug - Classic was out of stock (red dot), so I had to use Blue Mug - Large instead — both are 'Blue Mugs' but only the Large one was in stock

    Baseline · Shop page

Static checker vs real journeys

axe-core flags 1 rule(s) on the 4 pages the agents visited. Agents found 3 perspective(s) blocked, of which no rule detects: Colour blindness, Keyboard only.

  • seriousElements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds (color-contrast, 1 element(s))

Fixes, before and after

  • WCAG 1.4.1 Use of Color Say the stock status in words, not only with a coloured dotIn shop_page(), render the status as text next to the dot, e.g. <span class="stock">In stock</span> / <span class="stock">Out of stock (ships in 6 weeks)</span>, and keep the dot as a decorative extra (aria-hidden="true").
  • WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow Let the cart reflow at 200% zoomIn cart_page() CSS, replace `.layout { width: 1200px }` with `max-width: 1200px; width: 100%`, remove `overflow-x: hidden` from html/body, and place the checkout control in the normal flow instead of `position: absolute; right: 0`.
  • WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard Make 'Proceed to checkout' a real linkIn cart_page(), replace `<div class="checkout" onclick="location.href='/checkout'">` with `<a class="checkout" href="/checkout">Proceed to checkout</a>` and add a visible :focus-visible style.
  • WCAG 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) Give the order total readable contrast and sizeIn checkout_page() CSS, set `.total { color: #1a1a1a; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700 }`.
